films.title: F-IT ALL
films.description: Fit Bike Co.'s fifth feature-length team film, F-IT ALL, follows a 20-rider roster across street, park, and trails riding. The 2022 film was filmed and edited by Justin Benthien and runs 36 minutes, 30 seconds.

sourceRecords.sourceDetails: Public, embeddable complete film on Fit Bike Co.'s official YouTube channel; exact runtime 36:30. The official description identifies it as the complete full-length and names nine featured riders.
Fit Bike Co.'s first-party complete-film page embeds the official YouTube upload, labels it the full video, and provides official artwork and featured riders.
Fit Bike Co.'s first-party release page supplies the full 20-rider roster and credits Justin Benthien for filming and editing.
DIG BMX independently confirms the December 2022 complete-film release, the official Fit upload, and Justin Benthien's filming credit.
Independent BMX retailer metadata confirms the feature-length film, 20-rider credits, Justin Benthien filming/editing credit, and exact 36:30 runtime.

rights.basis: Catalog metadata and embed of Fit Bike Co.'s official YouTube upload; no media rehosting permission inferred. No film-wide location list was published, so no locations were inferred.
